messages.subject: Problems doing TMT experiment
parts:
Hello, my name is Fabio Montoni and I just started using R and I found out MsStats is an amazing way to produce powerful Mass Spectrometry results, however I’m having some trouble to use in my samples.

This is how I did my experiment. It’s only one Mixture, with 5 controls in first 5 channels (126,127N,127C,128N,128C) and 5 treated in the other ones (129N,129C,130N,130C, 131), as shown below:

Everything seem to be fine, until I get an error saying that there is a missing channel, and when I add an eleventh one with “Empty” line this issue seems to be solved, but I am not sure if it is the right thing to do.

When I proceeded to the next parts of the script, I encountered this error:



I wanted please, if possible some direction of what to do.

Best regards.

messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: Problems doing TMT experiment
parts:
Hi Fabio,

For the missing channel error, it is probably because the channel IDs should be channel.1 to channel.10, not channel.0 to channel.9. You can double-check the column names of your maxquant evidence file to confirm it. I have attached the updated annotation file. And are the three MS runs technical replicates or fractions of the mixture? From your annotation file, they seem to be technical replicates. 

Based on the information, it is hard to locate the error. If the same error occurs with the updated annotation file, could you share your evidence.txt and proteinGroups.txt files? So that I can reproduce the error.

Best,
Ting
